scope: test-owned region fixture fallback-audio lifecycle cleanup only; not full regression, formal gameplay, audio quality, release or device acceptance
findings: Read full proposal.patch, applied tracked two-file diff, existing AudioTeardown implementation, original trace/runner behavior, source_identity/results and raw normal/verbose logs. Applied change matches the narrow proposal: preload helper, cleanup before replacing a previous world, cleanup at three successful route tails, and final runner cleanup for early-return residual worlds.

All original route actions, positions, input drivers, resource checks, hazard/body-sweep checks, assertions, early failures and actual journey/tutorial summary markers remain. Cleanup occurs after observation or at fixture replacement, never mid-route. It does not reset health/ammo/H, warp the player, alter enemy/terrain state, skip a fixture or convert a failed route into a completed route.

Cleanup captures actual owned fallback playback weakrefs, stops voices and detaches streams before free, then waits conditionally for those exact backends. Deadline remains1000ms, measured from the receipt. A false result invokes original check callback, increments failure count, and yields FAILED>0/nonzero runner exit; replacement additionally returns false immediately. Ignoring the returned bool at a completed route tail does not suppress failure because original failure counters are already updated.

Runner final cleanup covers worlds left alive by early returns. It does not add missing journey markers; wrapper still rejects missing physical completion even if cleanup itself succeeds. Invalid/already-freed worlds return true and do not fabricate a release assertion or route completion.

Raw baseline_verbose_02 has the original66/0 functional result but actual OggPacketSequence/AudioStreamOggVorbis/AudioStreamPlaybackOggVorbis/OggPacketSequencePlayback leaks and bell.ogg resources at exit. baseline_verbose first attempt was clean and remains a timing-sensitive observation, not cancellation of the failed baseline.

Raw candidate verbose and normal both preserve3969ticks/8shots/safe=true and original66 assertions, adding exactly one actual release assertion for67/0. Both receipts name one actual bell.ogg playback backend and report release after19ms/64ms, with clean native exit. This is actual nonempty-owner evidence, not an empty weakref list or fixed delay. Logs identify Godot4.6.3.stable.official.7d41c59c4; no different-engine evidence is inferred.

Original two runner entry modes, full28 fixture inventory, all prior checks, per-fixture120s, whole-ledger1500s, strict ERROR/leak rejection and failure exit remain unchanged. Single-fixture candidate success supports the cleanup mechanism but is not proof of the full migrated region suite; root must complete the original full rerun and report actual terminal status before claiming full regression.
